# DOMARO Fragrances

DOMARO is an online fragrance store serving customers in Egypt. The catalog includes men's, women's and unisex perfumes, Arabic and oriental fragrances, gift boxes and selected fragrance houses.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://domaro.vercel.app/
- Shop: https://domaro.vercel.app/shop.html
- Brands: https://domaro.vercel.app/brands.html
- About: https://domaro.vercel.app/about.html
- Shipping: https://domaro.vercel.app/shipping.html
- Returns & Exchanges: https://domaro.vercel.app/returns.html
- FAQ: https://domaro.vercel.app/faq.html
- Contact: https://domaro.vercel.app/contact.html

## Shopping information
- Delivery is available across Egypt.
- Cairo and Giza orders are delivered within a maximum of 2 days.
- Other governorates may vary depending on destination, courier availability and order volume.
- Delivery fees depend on governorate and area.
- Product availability, sizes and pricing are shown on the product and checkout pages.
